Series::invalid¶

Back to Series API Reference

Signature¶

Series::invalid() const -> Series

What It Does¶

invalid() returns a boolean mask that is true exactly where a lane is not a usable finite numeric value.

On the current public surface that means:

  • floating lanes become true when they are nan, +inf, or -inf

  • complex lanes become true when either the real part or the imaginary part is non-finite

  • integral and boolean lanes stay false, because those dtypes do not carry nan or infinity states

Shape is preserved. invalid() does not remove values or repair them; it only classifies them.

Parameters¶

None.

Returns¶

Series A boolean Series with the same shape as self.

Gradient¶

invalid() is a diagnostic mask, not a differentiable numeric transform.

Examples¶

Example 1. A mixed matrix of ordinary values, nan, and infinities turns into an equally shaped boolean mask.

auto values = pluss::make_series({
    {1.0, std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN(), 2.0},
    {std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity(),
     -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity(),
     5.0},
});

pluss::series::print(std::cout, values.invalid());

Output¶

Series(shape=[2,3], strides=[3,1], dtype=bool, platform=cpu, numel=6, contiguous=true)
data=
⎡ false true false ⎤
⎣  true true false ⎦

Example 2. Integral input has no nan or infinity lanes, so the whole mask is false.

std::cout << pluss::make_series({1, 2, 3}, pluss::ScalarType::Int64).invalid();

Output¶

pluss::Series(shape=[3], strides=[1], dtype=bool, platform=cpu, numel=3, contiguous=true)
data=[false, false, false]

Gotchas And Failure Modes¶

  • invalid() preserves shape; it is for marking bad lanes, not extracting them.

  • If the next step is repair, pair this with nan_to_num() or a branch like where().

  • If the next step is compaction into positions, use invalid_index().

Summary¶

Use invalid() when the main question is “where are the bad numeric lanes?” rather than “what should I replace them with?”

See Also¶

  • Series::invalid_index: compact the same diagnosis into flat positions.

  • Series::isfinite: broader finite-value detector with the same shape-preserving mask style.

  • Series::nan_to_num: replace invalid lanes with explicit policy values.
